items.summary: compressor-framework.cu and decompressor-framework.cu use strcmp with only <string> included, so the generated standalone compressor/decompressor need -include cstring under libstdc++ (clang-cl is unaffected because MSVC's <string> pulls it in). Fold a #include <cstring> into the standalone templates during PR-prep so the documented hipcc recipe works unmodified everywhere; deliberately kept out of the documentation-only commit f0ce8ce, which must stay carry-forward.
